content: UTF-8 BOM CSV for Windows Excel: Use encoding='utf-8-sig' which automatically adds/strips BOM. For BytesIO: write to StringIO with csv.writer(buf, delimiter=';'), then content = buf.getvalue().encode('utf-8-sig'), then wrap in BytesIO(content). utf-8-sig encoding signals UTF-8 to Excel on Windows preventing Cyrillic mojibake. Semicolon delimiter matches Windows European locale List Separator default.
